17:29 < Filip> MouseLRN,  I'll paste  (part of) the reversed CE code for touchpanel poweron:
17:29 < MouseLRN> ok, I'll try it now
17:30 < Filip>     DWORD * ptr; 
17:30 < Filip>      
17:30 < Filip>     ptr = (DWORD *) (g_RegistersMap + 0x1118); 
17:30 < Filip>     if ((*ptr & 0x0001) == 0) *ptr |= 0x0001; 
17:30 < Filip>     ptr = (DWORD *) (g_RegistersMap + 0x03C8); 
17:30 < Filip>     if ((*ptr & 0x0003) == 0) *ptr |= 0x0003; 
17:30 < Filip>     ptr = (DWORD *) (g_RegistersMap + 0x0300); 
17:30 < Filip>     *ptr |= 0x0001;                                   // reset? 
17:30 < Filip>     while (*ptr & 0x0001); 
17:30 < Filip>     * (DWORD *) (g_RegistersMap + 0x0308) = 1500;     // sample rate? 
17:30 < Filip>     * (DWORD *) (g_RegistersMap + 0x030C) = 200;      // voltage stabilization time? 
17:30 < Filip>     * (DWORD *) (g_RegistersMap + 0x0310) = 0x0032; 
17:30 < Filip>     * (DWORD *) (g_RegistersMap + 0x0318) = 0x0001; 
17:30 < Filip>     * (DWORD *) (g_RegistersMap + 0x0300) &= ~0x0008; 
17:30 < Filip>     * (DWORD *) (g_RegistersMap + 0x0300) &= ~0x0020; 
17:30 < Filip>     * (DWORD *) (g_RegistersMap + 0x0300) &= ~0x00C0; 
17:30 < Filip>     * (DWORD *) (g_RegistersMap + 0x0300) |= 0x0300; 
17:30 < Filip>     * (DWORD *) (g_RegistersMap + 0x0300) &= ~0x0020; 
17:30 < Filip>     * (DWORD *) (g_RegistersMap + 0x0300) |= 0x0004; 
17:30 < Filip>     * (DWORD *) (g_RegistersMap + 0x0304) |= 0x1D00; 
17:30 < Filip>     * (DWORD *) (g_RegistersMap + 0x0304) |= 0x00FF;
17:31 < MouseLRN> DWORD == unsigned long ?
17:31 < andrey> unsigned 32-bit
17:31 < Filip> andrey is the wizard that made up this C code out of a binary dump
17:32 < andrey> yes, and then gave up at some point. :-)
17:32 < MouseLRN> Filip this code cut from Casio SDK?
17:33 < Filip> no, andrey took a  memory dump from a running  BE
17:33 < andrey> and tried to restore the code from it
17:33 < Filip> and reverse engineered the binary back up to readable portions of  C code
17:34 < andrey> But there are too many unknown things... :-(
17:34 < MouseLRN> ;-) where you get 'tch_ddsi.c' name?
17:34 < Filip> that allowed us  to get serial working as well
